title: HDFC Tata Neu Plus credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A mid-tier Tata Neu Plus variant offering NeuCoins on Tata partner purchases, milestone benefits, and lifestyle rewards for regular Tata ecosystem users.

mileStoneItems.benefits: Get 499 NeuCoins on Tata Neu App (as reversal of 1st Year Membership Fees).Welcome Benefit will be available to claim inside Tata Neu App within 60 days of such transaction.
The renewal fee will be waived.
